group.title: Configure lighting group
group.description: Choose physical lights and child groups. Each has one primary parent. Confirm moves explicitly. Empty groups are allowed. Saving configuration sends no lighting commands. {error}

data.name: Group name
data.allow_moves: Confirm moving lights or children from another parent

data_description.power_policy: RESTORE turns on OFF lights at retained levels. FULL sets available lights to full brightness. Explicit brightness or color uses RESTORE.
data_description.missing_members: Deselecting removes membership; presets targeting that physical identity must be repaired.
data_description.remove_orphans: Move all direct lights and children first. Repair directly referencing presets in this workflow before Save.

group_preview.title: Review topology and preset changes
group_preview.description:
Effective preset values and their sources are recalculated before saving. Invalid recipes must be repaired in this workflow.

recipe.title: Edit absolute recipe
recipe.description: Only assigned properties are stored. More specific targets override each inherited property independently.

remove_target.title: Choose assignment to remove
remove_target.description: Removing an assignment restores inheritance for its properties.

preset_preview.title: Review effective preset
preset_preview.description:

repair_preset.description: Changes remain private until the topology preview is saved.

set_master.name: Set relative master
set_master.description: Scale current physical brightness while preserving power and independent child masters. Select one group or disjoint groups. Overlapping relative targets are rejected.

control.name: Control absolute properties
control.description: Send sparse absolute properties to groups or configured physical leaves in one coherent operation. Strict property kinds are preserved. Ancestor/leaf overlaps deduplicate identical assignments; conflicting assignments are rejected.

properties.name: Sparse properties
properties.description: power: on/off; brightness_pct: (0,100]; color_temp_kelvin: positive integer; color: {kind: rgb/hs/xy, value: array}; effect: advertised name. Omitted power preserves OFF state.

assignments.name: Explicit batch assignments
assignments.description: Use instead of target plus properties: list of {entity_id: light ID or list, properties: sparse assignments}. Conflicting per-leaf properties reject the entire batch.

activate_preset.name: Activate preset
activate_preset.description: Activate one J’ai preset scene with hierarchical per-property inheritance. Optional response reports skipped properties, clamps and failures.

get_topology.name: Get lighting topology
get_topology.description: Return the shared topology, stable identities, sparse recipes, retained state and resolved entity references. Requires a response.
